subject: Milestone billing & Net-60 request — Solstice Health
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@solsticehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@solsticehealth.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: milestone/quarterly invoicing + Net-60 term

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Our procurement group needs to confirm billing cadence before we route an official PO. Two asks from our side: can Redwood support

- milestone-based invoicing on a quarterly cadence (Q3/Q4 milestones tied to integration milestones), and
- Net-60 payment terms on signed invoices (our standard is Net-60 for new vendors).

We can commit to a 12-month contract and expect the first milestone to land in early August. Also asking if a small contract-level discount (we can propose a 7% volume discount) is available in exchange for quarterly milestone billing.

Attached: Solstice_PO_Request.pdf (PO intake worksheet)

Can you confirm if this is something Redwood can do and what approvals are required? We have an internal deadline to get a PO out by 7/7.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Director, Procurement
Solstice Health

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: milestone/quarterly invoicing + Net-60 term

Daniel — appreciate the clarity and timeline. Short answer: we can usually support milestone-based invoicing and Net-60, but this is a non-standard commercial term that requires Deal Desk/Finance sign-off and a couple of conditions from Legal.

Proposed commercial approach (provisional):
- Term: 12 months, $540,000 ARR (billing by milestone: 4 quarterly invoices tied to SOW milestones)
- Payment: Net-60 on each issued invoice
- Discount: provisional 7.5% one-time contract-level discount if PO and SOW signed by 7/15
- Conditions: credit check, PO on file, and a signed SOW with milestone acceptance criteria.

I've attached a draft mutual-action plan and included Marissa (AE) and Laura (Legal) to start the internal approval loop. Marissa — can you route to Deal Desk and Finance? Laura — any legal flags on milestone acceptance language?

Attachments: MA-Plan-Draft.pdf

Next steps: I will escalate for a quick Deal Desk review today and aim to loop back before your PO deadline.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: Solstice billing request — Deal Desk review needed

Forwarding Daniel's request and Michael's proposed commercial approach.

Notes from AE:
- ARR/contract-level: $540k annualized (4 quarterly milestone invoices)
- Discount requested: ~7% (Michael quoted 7.5% provisional)
- Timeline: PO by 7/7; SOW signature target 7/15

Finance commentary requested: impact to DSO, credit exposure, and whether we can accept Net-60 without prepayment. Attached is a quick credit mem and expected billing schedule.

Attachment: solstice_credit_memov2.xlsx

Rishi — flagged as moderate risk. If Deal Desk recommends, we should propose mitigations: 25% upfront, ACH/PO on file, or reduce discount to 5%. Please advise with a recommended P&L/AR control.

Marissa
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Solstice — Non-standard payment terms (Net-60) + discount request

Team — I reviewed the numbers and credit mem. Quick summary for exec review:
- Contract: $540k ARR; expected billing schedule: 4 x $135k quarterly invoices
- Exposure: ~120 days of DSO if Net-60 honored per invoice timing and acceptance windows
- Risk: Solstice is a mid-market health SaaS; credit checks are clean but no existing AR history with Redwood
- Recommendation: Approve Net-60 + quarterly milestone invoices with the following controls: 1) 25% initial invoice due on SOW signature (applied to first milestone), 2) PO requirement, 3) 5% approved commercial discount (instead of 7.5%), and 4) late fee clause (1.5% monthly) after Net terms.

Attached: finance_summary.csv (simple cash-flow impact model)

This needs executive approval (VP Commercial or CFO). Michael — can you put this in front of Vanessa for quick sign-off? Approval needed by 6/30 to meet procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance Operations
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: Solstice — Non-standard payment terms (Net-60) + discount request

I've reviewed the summary and finance impact. Approved, with conditions:
1) Accept Net-60 and quarterly milestone invoicing for this account only; approval valid for this 12-month agreement.
2) Discount capped at 5% (approved) — do not provide the 7.5% one-time.
3) Require 25% initial invoice on SOW signature (to reduce exposure).
4) Include PO on file, explicit milestone acceptance criteria in SOW, and a 1.5% monthly late fee clause.
5) Legal (Laura) to confirm milestone acceptance language mirrors completion metrics; finance (Rishi) to own AR triggers.

Michael — communicate back to Daniel with the approved terms and updated MA plan. Please copy Finance and Legal on the final SOW and route to DocuSign.

Attachment: approved_terms_doc.docx

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Commercial Operations
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
